reviewQuestions: Are conformity pathways and prerequisites correctly modeled?
Are EU declaration, CE marking and registration represented as distinct non-automatic legal gates?
Does registration fail closed until the applicable official EU database/process is operational and legally available for the system?
scope: conformity-assessment pathways for applicable high-risk systems
EU declaration of conformity, CE marking and registration sequence
official EU database availability and applicable registration timeline
evidence and approval gates preventing false completion
officialSources: applicable Annex VI or VII pathways and product-sector legislation

preReviewFindings.finding: The platform must never issue or imply formal conformity, an EU declaration, CE marking or registration authority.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Approve fail-closed gates and all non-certification wording.

preReviewFindings.finding: Applicable pathway depends on system category, harmonised standards, common specifications and sector law.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Confirm decision inputs and mandatory external-assessor escalation.

preReviewFindings.finding: EU database registration is an external statutory step whose practical availability depends on the official Article 71 database/process and the applicable amended implementation date. Software readiness cannot be recorded as actual registration.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Confirm the registration trigger, timing, external evidence required and fail-closed behavior until the official route is available.

preReviewFindings.finding: Commercial materials and contracts must describe conformity support consistently.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Align approved claims and contractual scope after founder facts are confirmed.

acceptanceCriteria: No automatic conformity, declaration, CE or registration outcome exists.
Pathway prerequisites and notified-body dependencies are accurate.
Registration follows only after valid external prerequisites and official process availability.
Marketing and contract wording matches the technical boundary.
humanInputsRequired: notified-body or sector-specialist input when applicable
limitations: Risck Comply is not a notified body, conformity-assessment body or market-surveillance authority.
The product cannot issue an EU declaration of conformity, CE marking or statutory registration.
Availability of the official EU database and sector-specific registration path is external to RISCK COMPLY.
External standards and sector-law evidence remain outside repository proof.
